agent_answered.text: "For agents, the $1,000-phone gesture is handing over the whole general surface: the agent arrives with its memory, tools, and file access attached, exactly like the contacts and photos riding along on the phone. A general surface earns trust back when the cost-per-use becomes visible before the handover — a scoped subagent or sandboxed copy is the $100 gadget version of the same agent, bad at ever" [b8067843-4dff-487e-a2b4-87dbd184573a]
